info.name: Mist Admins Sites Clients - Wired API

params.name: distinct
params.description: Field used to group this count response. enum: `mac`, `port_id`, `vlan`

params.name: mac
params.description: Filter results by MAC address

params.name: device_mac
params.description: Filter results by device MAC address

params.name: port_id
params.description: Filter results by port identifier

params.name: vlan
params.description: Filter results by VLAN ID

params.name: start
params.description: Lower bound of the time range, as an epoch timestamp in seconds or a relative value such as `-1d` or `-1w`

params.name: end
params.description: Upper bound of the time range, as an epoch timestamp in seconds or a relative value such as `-1d`, `-2h`, or `now`

params.name: duration
params.description: Time range duration for the query, using relative units such as `10m`, `7d`, or `2w`

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return per page

items.docs: Count wired clients for a site, optionally grouped by the `distinct` field and filtered by MAC address, switch port, VLAN, and time range. Use [Count Org Wired Clients](/#operations/countOrgWiredClients) to count wired clients across the organization.

params.name: device_mac
params.description: Filter results by device MAC address

params.name: mac
params.description: Filter results by MAC address

params.name: ip
params.description: Filter results by IP address

params.name: port_id
params.description: Filter results by port identifier

params.name: source
params.description: Filter results by client learning source. enum: `lldp`, `mac`

params.name: vlan
params.description: Filter results by VLAN ID

params.name: manufacture
params.description: Filter results by manufacturer

params.name: text
params.description: Single entry of hostname/mac

params.name: nacrule_id
params.description: Filter results by NAC rule identifier

params.name: dhcp_hostname
params.description: Filter results by DHCP hostname

params.name: dhcp_fqdn
params.description: Filter results by DHCP FQDN

params.name: dhcp_client_identifier
params.description: Filter results by DHCP client identifier

params.name: dhcp_vendor_class_identifier
params.description: DHCP Vendor Class Identifier

params.name: dhcp_request_params
params.description: Filter results by DHCP request parameters

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return per page

params.name: start
params.description: Lower bound of the time range, as an epoch timestamp in seconds or a relative value such as `-1d` or `-1w`

params.name: end
params.description: Upper bound of the time range, as an epoch timestamp in seconds or a relative value such as `-1d`, `-2h`, or `now`

params.name: duration
params.description: Time range duration for the query, using relative units such as `10m`, `7d`, or `2w`

params.name: sort
params.description: On which field the list should be sorted, -prefix represents DESC order

params.name: search_after
params.description: Pagination cursor for retrieving subsequent pages of results. This value is automatically populated by Mist in the `next` URL from the previous response and should not be manually constructed.

items.docs: Search wired clients for a site with filters for device MAC address, client MAC address, IP address, switch port, VLAN, manufacturer, DHCP attributes, NAC rule, and time range. Use [Search Org Wired Clients](/#operations/searchOrgWiredClients) to search wired clients across the organization.
